name: The Long Span
descriptionSeed: Not a city — a MOVING settlement, tents and roads and a people for whom everywhere is a place not yet arrived. The Horizon-Walkers have no fixed anything and consider that a completed thought rather than a lack. Staying, to them, is the strange behavior that requires explanation.
encounterFlavor: Walkers who will take you anywhere and will not stay; a settlement that will be somewhere else next month; someone who stopped walking, and what it did to them.
questSeeds: A Walker has stopped, and their people are treating it like a death
The Span's route has been blocked, and they have never had to go AROUND anything
worldPosNote: A place people pass through or live in — pulled inward of its Reach's pole. (SNG-180: authored position — WHERE it sits. Independent of axisVector, which is WHAT it is; a bastion is where the two disagree.)
appearance: A moving settlement of tents and awnings pitched in loose rows along a broad track, with carts and pack animals drawn up between them. Nothing permanent. Ruts in the ground behind it, open country ahead.

carriage.why: The Horizon-Walkers strike camp and move it themselves — no apparatus, no beast, no drift. The round is 414 miles and takes a season and a half at the pace of people who are not hurrying, because arriving is not what the walk is for.

_carriage_20260914: ⛔ SNG-591, Erik 2026-09-14: 'the Horizon-Walkers have a settlement called the Long Span… it moves. That would be a good use of the new carriage capability.' ⛑ THREE PLACES MOVE, NOT ONE — the Long Span, the Unlanded and the Wend all say so in their own prose and all three sat still. ⚠️ A LOCATION HAS NO SECOND GRAPH TO MOVE ALONG AND DOES NOT NEED ONE: `connections` already names where each goes, and all 138 locations carry `worldPos`, so `voyagePosition`'s arithmetic works on a place today without a new field. ⛔ WHAT IS NEW IS THE SHAPE: a holding makes a VOYAGE from A to B and arrives; a settlement keeps a CIRCUIT and comes round. `daysPerCircuit` divided across the legs gives the leg it is on for any world day, which is the same lerp `voyagePosition` already does. ⬜ NOTHING READS `location.carriage` YET — specced for CCode, and dead until it is wired.
